fingerprintDefinition: Sorted modified and untracked paths under jeeves-rs against base. For each append UTF-8 path, NUL, and binary SHA-256 of its contents. Hash the concatenation with SHA-256.
environment: macOS, isolated temporary homes, scripted model and local connector fixtures

scenarios.scenario: Chinese mail assignment through interaction/start, replay same message ID
scenarios.before: The main request advertised direct mail and file writes that its execution policy refused.
scenarios.after: One task, one run and one on-disk draft matched the specified recipient, subject and body. The main model saw the handoff and read tools.

scenarios.scenario: Deferred discovery and context overflow retry
scenarios.before: The first main request hid task.
scenarios.after: All three observed requests exposed task, permitted memory actions and consistent session instructions. Discovery did not offer worker-only mail or file tools.

scenarios.scenario: Cancelled main interaction followed by ordinary turn/start
scenarios.before: An ordinary turn could inherit the earlier scoped task tool.
scenarios.after: An ordinary turn received no task handoff from the cancelled interaction.

scenarios.scenario: Find and resume an old task after another conversation adds 100 tasks
scenarios.before: The main list reported no tasks.
scenarios.after: Exactly two owned tasks appeared, newest first. Continuing the explicitly selected older task reused its ID, execution session and directory. Its run count increased to two. The newer task stayed at one run.

checks.scripts/smoke-interaction.py: Passed with the shipped HTTP adapter, temporary home and local provider.
checks.scripts/smoke-promotion.py: Passed. Stale approval refused, final approved content posted once to the simulated Feishu receiver and one completion returned to main chat.
checks.just smoke-recovery: Eight process fixtures passed. An effect interrupted before confirmation stopped for review. Its receiver observed one effect.
